name: anchor: roles
description: Copy of "anchor: roles" that sends resource_type when it creates a role or permission. It replaces the original once ADR-0022 PR 1 is deployed. Product role CRUD, name uniqueness, permission assign / unassign (no-ops emit nothing), a role held by a member cannot be deleted, one not-found code (ROLE_NOT_FOUND) on GET/PUT/DELETE/assign/unassign, and every role event checked in one final webhook wait. Atomic permission writes (anchor#163): role C's two assigns run concurrently; role E takes four concurrent assigns racing a rename-only PUT, then holds exactly all four and the new name, with exactly one product.role.updated per write; a PUT with permissions replaces the set (response and fresh read exact).
